description: Machine-readable ownership map for Unit Talk monorepo. Defines responsibility boundaries, change risk levels, and verification requirements.

areas.responsibility: Claude OS execution layer governance framework
areas.notes: Changes here alter Claude's execution rules. Must be reviewed for consistency with CLAUDE_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md and SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md.

areas.responsibility: Hard law — non-negotiable invariants for all Claude operations
areas.notes: Highest authority document. Changes require explicit human decision and careful review of downstream impacts.
Defines system safety boundaries. Changes may affect runtime behavior.

areas.responsibility: Domain contracts — data formats, API boundaries, behavior expectations
areas.notes: Contract changes may break consumers. Verify all dependent systems.
Should reflect actual system state. Update when implementation changes.

areas.responsibility: Core runtime — agents, grading, settlement, lifecycle enforcement. CANONICAL WRITER to unified_picks.
areas.notes: Changes here affect live data processing. Lifecycle adapter changes affect all pick writes. Runtime proof required for behavior changes.
This is the enforcement layer for single-writer discipline. Changes must pass lifecycle gate and include runtime verification.
Agent changes affect live data pipelines. Require runtime evidence in proof bundles.
Data pipeline entry point. Must target provider_offers (canonical), not raw_props (deprecated).
User-facing surface. Changes visible to end users immediately. Verify embed format against DISCORD_EMBED_CONTRACT.md.

areas.responsibility: Pick submission UI. Writes to bridge_outbox ONLY.
areas.notes: Must never write directly to unified_picks. All submissions go through bridge_outbox.

areas.responsibility: Operations dashboard. READ-ONLY — no writes to business tables.
areas.notes: Read-only surface. Build verification typically sufficient.

areas.responsibility: Analytics frontend. READ-ONLY — no writes to business tables.
areas.notes: Read-only surface. Build verification typically sufficient.

areas.responsibility: Shared TypeScript type contracts across apps
areas.notes: Type changes propagate to all consumers. Must verify all dependent apps still build.

areas.responsibility: Supabase client and database query utilities
areas.notes: Database access abstraction. Changes may affect query behavior across all apps.

areas.responsibility: Discord embed building and channel routing
areas.notes: Affects user-visible Discord output. Verify against DISCORD_EMBED_CONTRACT.md.
Core intelligence. Changes affect pick quality and tier assignment.
Observability infrastructure. Low risk unless removing health reporting.
[VERIFY] internal structure and scope before modifying.
Utility changes may affect multiple consumers.
Schema changes are effectively irreversible in production. Require rollback documentation and careful review.
Tooling changes affect governance automation.
Development utilities.

areas.responsibility: Sprint proof bundles and closeout reports
areas.notes: Gitignored. Local proof artifacts. Never modify after sprint ratification.
Changes affect live runtime behavior.

areas.responsibility: Claude session configuration — agents, rules, skills
areas.notes: Changes affect Claude session behavior. Verify consistency with CLAUDE.md.
Sprint order changes affect governance gate. Verify with sprint:gate.
